text: 证监会发布吴清在首届中国资本市场学术年会开幕式上的致辞，指出需进一步深化资本市场参与全球金融治理研究。成熟的资本市场天然具有开放性，在全球金融体系进入重新定义规则的新阶段，需加强对市场开放、规则制定、监管合作等问题的研究，重点关注人工智能、金融稳定、可持续金融等议题，推动建设协同共治的全球金融治理新生态；同时研究提升跨境投融资便利化问题，为国际投资者提供更多中国优质资产供给。
text_en: The CSRC released Wu Qing's speech at the opening ceremony of the first China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting, noting that research on the capital market's participation in global financial governance needs to be further deepened. A mature capital market is naturally open. As the global financial system enters a new stage of redefining rules, it is necessary to strengthen research on issues such as market opening, rule-making and regulatory cooperation, focus on topics such as artificial intelligence, financial stability and sustainable finance, and promote the building of a new ecosystem of collaborative global financial governance; at the same time, study ways to enhance cross-border investment and financing facilitation and provide international investors with more high-quality Chinese assets.
